frontier.hypothesis: From the score-9 block-local base, extend copy_end's live range to cross one call so it becomes callee-saved s5 (not t0) without adding real refs, keeping index/cam_base/const in s2/s3/s4.

frontier.next_probe: sweep copy_end def/use placement relative to the tail calls; sandbox each; watch t0 -> s5 flip toward score 0.

frontier.hypothesis: From top-def (score 12, copy_end callee-saved but s2), nudge copy_end to LOWEST priority via live_length + the global.c:624 allocno-number tiebreak so it lands s5.

frontier.next_probe: declare copy_end last, delay its first reference; sandbox each variant.
